title: Deterministic results.json refusals (directory, symlink, deleted after a good read) are re-read every rescan and republish state
outcome: A run whose results.json is deterministically refused no longer makes every idle test-run rescan republish state. The refused cases are: the path is a directory, the path is a symlink (refused by review_freeze_file_observed), or results that vanished after an earlier good read (Missing with read_failures > 0). In each case the rescan either keeps a stable entry while nothing changes, or the history projection compares those entries by content instead of Arc identity. Transient I/O failures still recover on the next pass.
acceptance: A focused test shows that an unchanged rescan over an indexed run whose results.json is a directory, a symlink, or vanished after a good read neither advances the state revision nor publishes a new test-run projection, while a transient read failure is still read again on the next pass.
